page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a threads-per-core ratio of 1.0, each of the 80 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory density relative to vCPUs positions this instance in the memory-optimized hardware class, which offers resource density for memory-bound applications but carries a higher cost profile compared to general-purpose instances. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, making it unsuitable for local-disk-intensive or hardware-accelerated workloads. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, memory-intensive data processing, and caching layers.
